lines.text: if not all(isinstance(value, int) for value in values):

caption.vi: Tổng đệ quy có base case, quá trình unwind và phép đối chiếu với phiên bản lặp.
caption.en: A recursive sum with a base case, unwind trace and iterative equivalence check.

invariant_or_criterion.en: Which frame is created, which reaches the base case, and in what order do values unwind? ALGORITHM_REWRITE: event call must match the independently rerun trace and preserve the displayed state transition.
